title: Founder Live Agent Work Assignment Readiness
objective: Move governed queue admission candidates into local, operator-reviewed agent work assignment readiness records so founder-facing agent flow can show prepared assignment lanes without dispatching agents, running workers/tools, mutating projects, calling providers, using hosted DB writes, deploying, networking, packaging, or spending.
safetyRules: Implement one subphase at a time.
Do not modify projects/**, careloop/**, generated project sources/tests, providers/**, tools/**, worker-runtime/**, deploy/**, release/**, exports/**, packages/**, or .env*.
P113.1 is contract-only and must not modify db/**, live-ready/**, dashboard/src/**, dashboard/tests/**, local-state/runtime/**, or runtime data.
Later P113 subphases may only add governed local SQLite CRUD for allowlisted NEXUS OS work assignment readiness records where explicitly scoped.

Do not enable hosted DB mutation, raw SQL, provider/model calls, agent dispatch, worker/tool execution, project creation, project mutation, runtime admission, execution unlock, network calls, deploy, release, export, package creation, or provider spend.
Do not expose DemoApp in full Command Center.
Do not show project/private raw IDs in primary UX.
Do not invent fake working actions.
reuseRequired: existing Command Center route matrix, tabs, cards, badges, evidence, audit, and activity helpers
